Hi Jordan,

Many thanks — this looks good overall and we appreciate the thoughtful structure. Our comms team has two small edits:
1) Please remove the specific patient-count metric in the "Outcomes" section (we prefer a qualitative statement or a percentage improvement).
2) Update the quote attribution to use our internal style (see comment in the attached PDF).

We're happy to be featured and ok with the webinar clip and slide deck provided the edits above are made. I've attached our logo pack for the web (ZIP of PNG/SVG) and the VistaHealth brand guide — our brand team prefers the horizontal lockup for banners and the mono logo for small icons.

Attachment: vista_logo_pack.zip (images), vista_brand_usage.pdf (PDF)

I'll need final sign-off from legal on the edited draft. Samir, can you confirm if legal needs to sign a standard PR release or if comms sign-off is sufficient?

Best,

Thanks for the ping — reviewed VistaHealth's requested edits and the attached draft. Legal is comfortable with publication once the following two items are handled:

1) Remove the explicit patient-count number in the "Outcomes" section; replace with either a percent improvement (">50% reduction in latency") or a qualitative statement ("significantly reduced processing time").
2) Include a short "Approval" footer on the final PDF stating: "Approved for publication by VistaHealth on <date>" and request a signed acknowledgement (email reply from VistaHealth comms is sufficient; DocuSign not required for this asset).

Once Jordan obtains VistaHealth's confirmed language and a quick email sign-off, marketing can publish. Please make sure the web logo uses the horizontal lockup per VistaHealth's guide and that we host Vista's original SVGs (do not convert).

I've attached a brief checklist for marketing/legal handoff.

Attachment: legal_marketing_publish_checklist.pdf

Greenlight to proceed after those items are completed.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Associate General Counsel, Redwood Inference
